about_the_game:
This is the original soundtrack for the game Break the Empire.

Created by the game's developer, Mattias Myde, this soundtrack is available for your personal enjoyment and also serves as an additional way to support the solo developer behind the game.

Featuring approximately 40 minutes of music divided into 14 tracks:
- 11 adventurous and exciting songs used during gameplay.
- 3 bonus tracks, including the victory and defeat fanfares, as well as the main menu theme.

The soundtrack is provided in both MP3 and FLAC formats.

﻿
